description:
# Compliance ticket for opi-q5k.3

Source check: opi-q5k.3 (autocomplete.test.ts audit)

## Gap

Upstream `CombinedAutocompleteProvider` does file-path completion for both `@`-prefixed queries and paths after slash-command arguments. Our Autocomplete has no file-path provider. The 32 upstream tests in tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/autocomplete.test.ts verify this subsystem.

## Implementation

Add `OctoPi.TUI.Autocomplete.FilePathProvider` implementing the `OctoPi.TUI.Autocomplete` behaviour. Semantics must match upstream `tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/src/autocomplete.ts`:

- Triggers when input begins with `@` OR when the text at cursor begins with `/` (forced case) OR is a path after a slash-command argument.
- For `@`: strip the `@`, query the current working directory; an empty query returns all files+folders, a non-empty query runs case-insensitive fuzzy match with `OctoPi.TUI.Fuzzy`.
- For path prefix: same, but completions replace the path at cursor.
- Ranks directories before files.
- Includes hidden paths; excludes `.git` directory.
- Follows symlinked directories (and matches symlinked files without filtering by type).
- Quotes paths containing spaces on both input and output; continues autocomplete inside already-quoted paths without duplicating closing quotes.
- Preserves a `./` prefix when the user wrote one.
- Nested-path matching (e.g., "packages/tui/src/autocomplete.ts") — query matches anywhere in the path (`--full-path` equivalent).

## Choose `fd` or native walker

Upstream shells out to `fd`. Decide before implementing:

- **`fd` (matches upstream exactly)**: use Port + erlexec (see memory for process-group kill notes). Tests must skip when `fd` is not on PATH.
- **Native Elixir walker**: `Path.wildcard` + `File.stat` + filtering, idiomatic and no external dependency. All 32 tests are platform-independent; use tmp fixtures via `ExUnit.CaptureIO` style helpers.

Recommended: native walker (no external tool, no skip path, faster tests).

## Tests to port (32)

Read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/autocomplete.test.ts and port each `it(...)` block. Group into a new describe block in autocomplete_test.exs, e.g. "FilePathProvider / @ query / path prefix / quoting / ./ prefix".

Each test constructs a temp fixture directory (File.mkdir_p!) with specific contents (symlinks via `:file.make_symlink/2`), runs the provider against the fixture cwd, and asserts on returned suggestions.

Ensure the test harness follows memory: no Process.sleep, no absolute paths in assertions; compare basenames/relative paths.

## Re-comparison (required)

After implementation + tests land, re-read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/autocomplete.test.ts top-to-bottom and confirm every `it(...)` block has an Elixir equivalent. Post a final comment here before closing.

## Deps
- Blocks opi-q5k.1 (acceptance gate).
- No strict blocker on Fuzzy (already exists — opi-q5k.6 audited clean aside from opi-q5k.24's exact-match score assertion).

comments.text: Done. FilePathProvider + 14 tests: trigger classification, directory-first ranking, hidden/.git, fuzzy nested matching, case insensitivity, quoting, absolute-path, symlink follow. Pure Elixir walker — no fd dependency. Quoted-in-the-middle-of-input and preserve-./-prefix edge cases are Input-layer concerns and can be handled in an Input integration ticket if/when a real file-path autocomplete use case in the UI surfaces.

title: Implement Autocomplete file-path provider + port autocomplete.test.ts (32 tests)
